dedupeText: mid century soul trio album aesthetic 1960s motown style bouffant hairstyles slab serif lime green asymmetrical layout soul trio vintage photography vertical stacking of subjects creates a diagonal tension against the right aligned text block lime green accents in clothing mirror the primary accent color in the display typography high contrast studio lighting on subjects creates deep shadows that blend into the dark background combine a vertical stack of high fashion subjects on the left with a right justified multi font typographic block in the negative space using a single vibrant accent color to link the two halves

recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-1960s album cover aesthetic featuring a trio of vocalists in a vertical stack on the left, set against a dark, textured background with high-contrast typography and decorative flourishes occupying the right-side negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stacking of subjects creates a diagonal tension against the right-aligned text block.
Lime green accents in clothing mirror the primary accent color in the display typography.
High-contrast studio lighting on subjects creates deep shadows that blend into the dark background.
coreInvariants: Subjects wearing matching lime green satin-finish garments
Dramatic 1960s bouffant hairstyles with high sheen
Right-justified text block with varying font weights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects stacked vertically on the left third of the frame, scaled to occupy the full height of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central subject's face, positioned at the vertical midpoint of the left side.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left subject, moves down the stack of faces, then jumps to the large display text on the top right, descending through the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy, dark negative space on the right side provides a canvas for the typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright lime green used for clothing and primary title text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Creamy white for secondary display text and tracklist.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright skin tones/clothing and the dark background; saturation is concentrated in the lime green elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky slab serifs with minimal stroke contrast.
Secondary titles use condensed, heavy sans-serif forms.
Tracklist uses a bold, wide sans-serif for legibility at small scales.
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard 1960s commercial typefaces.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast weight pairing between a heavy slab serif and a thick condensed sans-serif, unified by right-alignment.
graphicDevices: Thin, elegant white calligraphic swirls (filigree) framing the subtitle text.
Small geometric icons (cross-hatched squares) used as bullet points in the tracklist.

preserve: Lime green and white color split
Slab serif for the top line
avoid: Using modern geometric sans-serifs like Helvetica

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Stymie Black or Rockwell Extra Bold
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif display style of the era.
Provides the necessary condensed weight for the subtitle role.
Suitable for the small-scale tracklist information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of three women with 1960s bouffant hair and lime green satin tops, stacked vertically on the left side against a dark, slightly textured charcoal background. Leave the right half of the image as empty dark space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add right-aligned text in the top right quadrant. Use a heavy white slab serif for the top line. Below it, use a heavy lime green condensed sans-serif for the title, interspersed with thin white decorative swirls. At the bottom right, add a multi-line tracklist in small white bold sans-serif, using small square icons as separators.

verificationChecks: Is the lime green color consistent between the clothing and the text?
Is there a clear hierarchy between the slab serif and the condensed sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the stack
Specific shade of the accent color (e.g., orange or cyan instead of lime)
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles
The Motown logo in the bottom right corner
Specific facial features of the original subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the background texture isn't too distracting for the text.
Check that the lime green doesn't vibrate too harshly against the black.
Verify the vertical stack of subjects feels unified and not like three separate photos.
Confirm the decorative swirls do not overlap the letterforms in a way that reduces legibility.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a vertical stack of high-fashion subjects on the left with a right-justified, multi-font typographic block in the negative space, using a single vibrant accent color to link the two halves.
